turns.teacher: Good morning children. Sit down quietly, everybody. Today we do subtraction. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Write it in your copy.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you wrote 35? No, no. That is wrong. Arjun, you say next.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Arjoon, 35 also? Listen. Two is small, so we borrow. Twelve minus seven is five. Then four minus two is two. Answer is 25. Everybody say, 52 minus 27 is 25.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Mina, why you are counting on fingers? I told already. Borrow one ten, twelve minus seven, four minus two. BORROW one ten. Twelve minus seven. Four minus two. Understood?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Who has understood? Thumbs up. Sana, thumbs up? Okay, good, all understood.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now do this one. Forty three minus eighteen. Quickly, two minutes only.
turns.label: new_sum
